newsitem.title: USA: Police seek man who jumped off N.Y. ferry.
newsitem.headline: Police seek man who jumped off N.Y. ferry.

text.p: Police were searching the murky waters of the Hudson River near the Statue of Liberty Saturday for a 34-year-old man who jumped off a ferry after being chased by a group of men on the boat.
"Police scuba divers, aviation, the Harbour Patrol and U.S. Coast Guard are combing the area for him," a police spokesmen said.

The victim was waiting to buy a beer at the refreshment stand of the "American Legion" ferry when a female behind him took offence at what he was saying to her and became involved in an argument with him, a police spokesman said.
"The woman told six of her male friends about the remarks the victim made and they began to chase him through the boat to the lower deck where he jumped into the water," he added.
The ferry stopped and the crew searched the water but were unable to find the man, police said. The accident took place at 2:42 a.m. EDT.
There were 900 passengers aboard the ferry. Police were questioning eight people about the incident, five friends of the woman and three friends of the victim.
